prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for home new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect has been seen for adoption new screens across 2 completed tests.
Finish redesigns have hurt overall performance (-2.6% after noise correction across 2 completed tests).
Predictions have generally been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -2.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_screen: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Visual Carousel Layout: Replaces the default story layout with a visual carousel featuring pet animations to engage users at the start. (why: choose_path has a 23.8% drop-off rate and a high mean duration (514s), suggesting early user hesitation.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Restoration Hint: Adds a clear hint below sign-in explaining how account restoration works for returning pet owners. (why: Support emails show 8 reports of pets missing or reset after users signed in again.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Split Authentication Layout: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split layout separating single-click auth from standard account login. (why: Sign in conversion is 72.9% and support received reports of the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Tip Carousel Component: Adds a tip carousel component to the photo upload screen highlighting optimal lighting and camera angles. (why: Support reported 3 custom pet generation failures and median adoption time is 89 seconds.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Card Grid Redesign: Redesigns the pick friend screen into a grid layout featuring archetype choice cards. (why: Adoption has a 33.8% drop-off rate, indicating potential confusion or friction during pet selection.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Notification Toggle: Enables time estimates and ready notifications on the waiting screen while background assets build. (why: Home waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), leaving users unsure if pet creation is working.)
6: [home, new_flow] Desktop System Verification Flow: Inserts a new system check screen during the waiting stage to confirm display and desktop overlay permissions. (why: Support logged 3 cases where pets failed to show on the desktop or the app failed to launch post-setup.)
7: [finish, hint] Home Intro System Tray Control Hint: Adds an explicit hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop system tray shortcuts and hotkeys. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
8: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Quick Reference Screen: Adds a quick reference checklist screen at the end of onboarding summarizing key desktop gestures and controls. (why: Multiple support emails report post-onboarding confusion about desktop pet behavior and control options.)
9: [choose_path, incentive] Choose Path Mascot Encouragement Badge: Adds an animated mascot and quick-completion badge to the path selection screen. (why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users right at the start of onboarding.)

scores.note: Target step loses 23.8% of users with high mean duration; carousel layout may engage early drop-offs.
Sign-in has 27.1% drop-off and 8 support reports regarding account restoration; copy fix is cheap and effective.
Strong evidence from funnel and support stalling reports, though redesigns carry moderate confidence.
Adoption loses 33.8% of users; support reports and long step duration validate adding guidance tips.
High impact due to 33.8% drop-off, but evidence for adoption redesigns remains thin.
Extreme wait times at home step; toggle config is low cost and helps manage user expectations.
Support reports exist, but lessons show new screens and flows add friction and decrease conversion.
Finish drops 35.2% and support notes confusion; hint fix avoids redesign penalties at low cost.
Addressing support issues is good, but adding a new screen at finish stage historically degrades conversion.
Target step loses 23.8%; encouraging visual badge adds slight positive motivation.
